input: Book a flight for the family reunion in August

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the exact departure and destination cities is the most fundamental requirement — without it, no search can begin.
The number of passengers and their ages (adults, children, infants) directly affects pricing, seat selection, and booking complexity.
August spans 31 days; the specific travel dates (outbound and return) determine availability and fare options.
A budget ceiling determines which fare classes, airlines, and routing trade-offs are acceptable.
Preferences like non-stop vs. connecting, preferred airlines, or cabin class significantly narrow the search.
Knowing whether to book through a specific site, travel agent, or airline directly affects the next immediate action.
What the user values most — lowest price, shortest travel time, flexibility to change — defines what a 'good' booking outcome looks like.

gold.taskDescription: Research and book flights for the user and their family to attend a family reunion in August.

questions.title: What are the departure and destination cities?
questions.description: Identify the origin airport or city the user is flying from, and the destination airport or city closest to the reunion venue.

questions.title: How many passengers are traveling, and what are their ages?
questions.description: Determine the total headcount and whether any travelers are children or infants, which affects ticket pricing and seat requirements.

questions.title: What are the exact outbound and return travel dates?
questions.description: Pin down the specific departure and return dates in August to enable accurate flight searches.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the flights?
questions.description: Establish a maximum spend ceiling (per person or total) to filter fare options appropriately.

questions.title: Do you prefer non-stop flights or is a connection acceptable?
questions.description: Understand routing preferences, including any preferred airlines or cabin class (economy, business), to guide the search.

questions.title: Which platform or method do you want to use to book?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to book via a specific travel site (e.g., Google Flights, Expedia), airline directly, or a travel agent.

questions.title: What matters most — lowest price, shortest travel time, or flexibility?
questions.description: Clarify the top priority so trade-offs between cost, convenience, and refundable/changeable tickets can be made correctly.
